title: It Took 100 People to Pull One Crocodile From a Creek

scenes.text: It took 100 people to pull one crocodile out of a creek.
The crocodile was named Lolong, and he lived in the Philippines.
He was captured on September third, 2011, after weeks of trying.
He weighed 2,370 pounds, and the Guinness World Records called him the largest crocodile ever kept in captivity.
One animal, and a hundred people to move it.

description:
It took about 100 people to pull one crocodile out of a creek.
Lolong, a saltwater crocodile in the Philippines, measured 20 feet 3 inches, weighed 2,370 pounds, and was certified the largest crocodile in captivity.
Could you stand next to him?
first_comment: 20 feet 3 inches. Would you stand next to one?
